title: Derived finite-site word comparisons and pushed proper-refinement pasting
statement:
Let $R$ be a finite commutative ring. All schemes are Noetherian (they have finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings) [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Work in ordinary constant-$R$ module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $N_T=\nu_T^*$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $P_v^t=Rv_*^t$ and $J_j^t=j_!^t$ ($t=e,p$). Let $d_v:N P_v^e\to P_v^pN$ be the specified counit mate [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate], and $e_j:N J_j^e\to J_j^pN$ the canonical open comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. Let $\kappa^t_{b,a}:P_b^tP_a^t\cong P_{ba}^t$ be the canonical derived direct-image compositor, normalized as the inverse adjunction conjugate of composite inverse image, and $m^t_{b,a}:J_b^tJ_a^t\cong J_{ba}^t$ the canonical open compositor [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition]. All equations below include canonical functor associators. 
For $E\in D^+(X_e,R)$, every $J_j^eE$, $NE$, and etale intermediate $P_v^eJ_j^eE$ has a cohomological lower bound; $J_j^e,J_j^p,N$ preserve any specified lower bound. The sheaf maps $e_j$ and their composition law descend termwise. Every proper map between these schemes is qcqs, so its specified $d_v$ is invertible on bounded-below etale inputs. For any open $j:X\hookrightarrow W$ and proper $r:W\to V$, put
$$B_{r,j}=P_r^p(e_j)\circ d_r(J_j^e(-)):N_VP_r^eJ_j^e\longrightarrow P_r^pJ_j^pN_X.$$
This is a natural isomorphism; $(P_r^eJ_j^eE,B_{r,j}(E))$ is a bounded-below etale-origin witness for $P_r^pJ_j^pN_XE$.
For composable proper maps $a:A\to B$, $b:B\to C$, the named counit mates obey
$$d_{ba}\circ N_C(\kappa^e_{b,a})=(\kappa^p_{b,a}N_A)\circ P_b^p(d_a)\circ d_b(P_a^e(-)),$$
and $d_{\mathrm{id}}$ is the identity under the canonical unit identifications. The open maps obey the analogous equation with $e,m,J$; in particular $e_{\mathrm{id}}$ is the identity.
Finally, let $j_i:X\hookrightarrow W_i$ be open, $u:W_1\to W_2$ and $r_2:W_2\to V$ proper, $uj_1=j_2$, $r_1=r_2u$. Let $\alpha_u^e$ be the specified proper/open refinement map [def-weil-pbc-proper-open-comparison], and $\alpha_u^p$ its open-adjunct pro-etale counterpart [lem-sp-refinement-coefficient-mate]. Put
$$\rho^t=\kappa^t_{r_2,u}(J_{j_1}^t(-))\circ P_{r_2}^t(\alpha_u^t).$$
On $D^+(X_e,R)$ the computed maps satisfy
$$B_{r_1,j_1}\circ N_V(\rho^e)=(\rho^pN_X)\circ B_{r_2,j_2}.$$
The original proper/open refinement square need not be Cartesian. No coefficient presentation or base field is assumed.

proof.text: Use the exact extension-by-zero and comparison inverse-image instances with Functor.isGE_mapDerivedCategory_obj. Install the assumed IsGE bound locally, obtaining both etale bounds and the pro-etale bound. Every object is already typed in DerivedCategory.Plus, so no additional injective representative is needed to establish membership in the bounded-below category.

Proper morphisms are quasi-compact and quasi-separated by their existing instances. Apply isIso_fixedComparisonDirectImageMatePlus. Expanding the definition of finiteSiteWordComparison reduces its invertibility to composition and whiskering of these isomorphisms and the canonical open-extension isomorphism.

The etale normalization is the unit characterization of conjugateEquiv applied to derivedPlus_unit_comp_upperStarCompDerivedPlus. For the pro-etale normalization, conjugateEquiv_upperStarComp_hom identifies the underived unit equation. Apply derivedPlus_unit_comp_app and derivedPlus_comp_unit_app, and naturality of the right-derived lowerStarComp and its composition isomorphism. Cancellation of the canonical composition inverse gives exactly the prescribed conjugateIsoEquiv.

The canonical proper composition and identity equations are precisely comparisonDirectImagePlus_comp and comparisonDirectImagePlus_id. The fixed mate definition unfolds to their rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange map, with identical normalizations.

Invert the ordinary open-comparison coherence equation by composing with its inverse factors. Apply mapDerivedCategoryPlusSquareIso_comp to that ordinary equation. The localization square is the inverse of properOpenSiteExtensionIso, since derived natural isomorphisms preserve inverses. Invert the resulting component isomorphism equality to obtain the required open-composition law. This is exact termwise descent, with no injective or nonzero-object assumption.

For the open identity law use the identity clause of openImmersionLowerShriekComparison_coherence. A private generic localization calculation, with explicit independent category object and morphism universe binders, proves that an ordinary exact square satisfying a unit equation satisfies the same equation after deriving: test the natural transformations on Qh, cancel the invertible factorization maps, and use the ordinary identity degreewise. Cancel the inverse of properOpenSiteExtensionIso to obtain the displayed unit law.

Expand finiteSiteEtaleRefinement, finiteSiteProEtaleRefinement and finiteSiteWordComparison. Rewrite by comparisonDirectImagePlus_comp. Move the open comparison across the pro-etale direct-image compositor by naturality, and move the etale refinement across the fixed mate by its naturality. Expanding properOpenProEtaleIsoPlus yields its three-constituent site equation directly; functoriality and cancellation of its initial open comparison give precisely the required pushed-refinement equation. No Cartesian refinement square, base field or coefficient presentation is introduced.

Statement, stmt_deps and blueprint fields are byte-identical to live. The item is still unsplit on live and side-live, so nothing supersedes this delivery. It is not on the drop list, has no SGA citation and has no cycle (full-closure DFS). Every proof dep exists and is unmerged. All dependencies are on the unit's route except def-weil-pbc-direct-image (a definition) and the Mathlib leaf right-derived-plus-injective, so no tool_uses are needed. Steps 1-2: lower bounds come from the extension-by-zero exactness nodes (etale and pro-etale) and comparison-pullback-exact (2), plus exact-functor-bounded-below and an injective D+ representative with alpha_I invertible. Step 3: e_j and the open composition law descend through localization (2). Step 4: Noetherian schemes are qc (finite affine cover) and qs (01OY), so every morphism is qcqs by permanence (1), which meets the hypothesis of comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate; B is an iso and the witness is in D+. Step 5: I recomputed the d-compositor law. d_u is the mate of a_u^{-1}; mate-pasting (2) gives s_b(d_a)d_b(r_a); (3b) and (3a) with kappa equal to the inverse conjugate of the inverse-image compositors give the stated orientation. Step 6: d_id comes from a_id=1 and mate-pasting (4); e_id=e_id∘e_id plus invertibility gives e_id=1. Steps 7-8: I re-derived the naturality of d_{r2} at A and of kappa^p at e_1, then substituted the pro-etale clause of lem-sp-refinement-coefficient-mate (no cartesian hypothesis), which gives rho^p N ∘ B_{r2,j2}. Sources checked: Stacks proetale 09A6 (l.4696), 09AF (l.5076), more-etale 0F7I (l.3081), the other step tags against tags/tags, and the blueprint Locality paragraph. Edge cases checked: R=0, identity maps, negative lower bounds, the non-cartesian fold refinement Spec k⊔Spec k→Spec k, and empty X. No duplicate found: the trf and sp mate nodes are field-specialized or coefficient-change statements.
